title: About TRACMASS Documentation
content: About  About The original feature of the TRACMASS method is that it solves the trajectory paththrough each grid cell with an analytical solution of a differential equation which depends on the velocities on the gridbox walls. The scheme was originally developed by Do%CC%88o%CC%88s 1995 and Blanke andRaynaud 1997 for stationary velocity fields and hereafter further developed by Vries and Do%CC%88o%CC%88s2001 for time-dependent fields by solving a linear interpolation of the velocity field bot...
